parts:
Hello,


I am new to Distance and have been watching the different tutorial videos with no success. I am deaf and partially blind. I feel i might be missing some simple steps to use the program.


I have edited my data input to the correct format and have had trouble running analyses and reading the results.


On the analyses section i have run on set 1 but have not been able to receive a population size estimate of my target species.


Can someone please help and run my data set as well and see the errors. I am looking for someone who can help input and run analyses of my data. I have already written it up in the required format.


PLEASE, i will be willing to donate $100-200 for the help and support.


Thank you


Mohamed Lamine
